niche.q: Why is this paper needed? (the gap or problem the introduction sets up)

labels.overlooked-aspect: an aspect of a known problem nobody has addressed
labels.underexplored-setting: a setting (data regime, modality, scale, constraint) where existing work hasn't been tried or doesn't apply
labels.missing-evaluation: claims in the field lack proper evidence, measurement or benchmark
labels.prior-performance-limit: existing methods are not accurate/capable enough
labels.prior-cost-limit: existing methods are too slow, expensive or data-hungry
labels.prior-robustness-limit: existing methods break under shift, noise, attack or scale
labels.prior-assumption-limit: existing methods rely on assumptions that are too strong or unrealistic
labels.conflicting-evidence: results or explanations in the literature disagree
labels.assumption-challenged: a widely held belief is wrong (must quote the belief)
labels.new-setting-transfer: a known idea has not yet been applied to setting S
labels.new-problem: a new task, capability or demand that did not exist before

labels.method: a new model, algorithm, objective or training recipe
labels.dataset-benchmark: a dataset, benchmark or evaluation protocol
labels.task-formulation: a new problem formulation or task definition
labels.explanation: an explanation or mechanism for an observed behaviour
labels.characterization: a systematic characterization, e.g. scaling laws or large-scale study
labels.analysis-of-existing: an analysis or re-evaluation of existing methods
labels.negative-result: showing something does not work or does not hold

arc.q: Which belief does the paper change for the reader? (Davis-style 'what seems X is really Y')

labels.seems-necessary-isnt: something believed necessary (component, cost, data, step) is not; simpler suffices
labels.seems-to-work-doesnt: something believed to work fails, or works for a different reason than believed
labels.different-are-same: approaches or phenomena believed different are instances of one thing (unification)
labels.one-is-several: something treated as one thing is really several (decomposition, disentangling)
labels.tradeoff-resolved: two goals believed to be in tension can be had together
labels.local-is-general: an idea from one domain or scale transfers to another (or a general belief only holds locally)
labels.hidden-relation: two things believed unrelated are related, or a correlation is shown to be causal; a phenomenon is discovered and explained
labels.impossible-feasible: something believed infeasible or unknown is shown possible for the first time
labels.better-on-axis: no belief change: a standard improvement on an axis (accuracy, cost, robustness)

insight_origin.q: Where does the key insight come from?

labels.analogy: borrowed from another field or problem
labels.first-principles: derived from theory or first principles
labels.reframing: recasting the problem as a known, solved problem

evidence.q: What kinds of evidence carry the paper's main claim?

labels.benchmark-comparison: head-to-head results against baselines on benchmarks
labels.controlled-synthetic: toy or synthetic settings with known ground truth
labels.large-scale-study: large sweeps or measurements across many models/settings
labels.existence-demo: a demonstration that something can be done at all
